cards.example_en: We ate lunch at a square table in the canteen.

cards.scene: 城镇场所 · Places and Buildings
cards.example_en: Cars crawl along our street when children arrive.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们到校的时候，车辆在我们这条马路上缓慢行驶。

cards.scene: 城镇场所 · Places and Buildings
cards.example_en: Check the sum before you pay the restaurant bill.
cards.example_zh: 付餐馆账单之前，先把总和核对一遍。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：极好的
cards.example_en: The superb meal at Grandma's house needed no extra salt.
cards.example_zh: 奶奶家那顿极好的饭菜完全不用再加盐。

cards.scene: 城镇场所 · Places and Buildings
cards.example_en: Mum's surprise was tickets to the weekend match.
cards.example_zh: 妈妈给的惊喜是周末比赛的门票。

cards.scene: 城镇场所 · Places and Buildings
cards.example_en: Chocolate brought back from Switzerland filled the tin.
cards.example_zh: 从瑞士带回来的巧克力把那个罐子装满了。

cards.scene: 城镇场所 · Places and Buildings
cards.example_en: We changed planes in Taiwan on the way to see cousins.
cards.example_zh: 去看表亲的路上，我们在台湾换了飞机。

cards.scene: 城镇场所 · Places and Buildings
cards.example_en: Shops in this town close early on winter evenings.
cards.example_zh: 冬天的晚上，这座城镇里的商店关得很早。

cards.scene: 城镇场所 · Places and Buildings
cards.example_en: My grandparents live in a quiet village.
cards.example_zh: 我的祖父母住在一个安静的村庄。

cards.scene: 城镇场所 · Places and Buildings
cards.example_en: Machines in the workshop were loud during our visit.
cards.example_zh: 我们参观的时候，车间里的机器非常吵。

cards.scene: 城镇场所 · Places and Buildings
cards.example_en: The local youth meet in the gym on Saturday afternoons.
cards.example_zh: 当地青年每周六下午在体育馆聚会。

cards.scene: 城镇场所 · Places and Buildings
cards.example_en: Forgetting the cakes at home turned the party into a small disaster.
cards.example_zh: 蛋糕忘在家里，聚会变成了一场小灾祸。

cards.scene: 城镇场所 · Places and Buildings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：想象力
cards.example_en: With a little imagination, the cardboard became a spaceship.
cards.example_zh: 只要有一点想象力，纸板就变成了宇宙飞船。

cards.scene: 城镇场所 · Places and Buildings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：原料；成分
